name: Short Cut Creamy Pumpkin Penne Pasta with Sausage & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
142 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add pumpkin, cream, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (425 g) can pure pumpkin purée
½ cup heavy whipping cream
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Once the sauce is simmering, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add drained pasta and stir to combine; add reserved pasta water, 1 tablespoon at a time, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
